ja197:1.1: Having seen you he does not smile,
ja197:1.2: nor does he give you a welcome,
ja197:1.3: He does not give you his attention,
ja197:1.4: and he speaks out against you.
ja197:2.1: These are the dispositions that are established in a foe,
ja197:2.3: From which, seeing and hearing, the wise one can know who his foe is.
